ios.desc:
A simple way to use your pictures as reminders.

*App of the Day* - Lifehacker.com
*Featured App* - App Store's 'New and Noteworthy'

Take a photo of an important task. Set a reminder time, and you're done! With PhotoMind, reminders are a snap!

Additional Features:
- Reminder notes.
- Recurring reminders.
- Clutter-free camera-roll.
- Today widget reminders.
- Share your reminders.
- Add reminders easily from
   any shareable image.

Follow us on Twitter: @koedal
